title: "Home"
---

I am a senior postdoctoral researcher at the [University of Graz](https://www.uni-graz.at/en/), Austria, with a background in electrical/biomedical engineering and computer engineering. I work in the [Talent and Learning Research](https://begabungsforschung.uni-graz.at/en/) group at the [Department of Psychology](https://psychologie.uni-graz.at/en/).

My research lies at the intersection of neuroscience, psychology, and scientific computing, with a focus on number processing and arithmetic, EEG oscillations and connectivity, biomedical signal processing, applied machine learning and statistics, and scientific software development. I am committed to open science and open source, including the open availability of data and analysis code to promote reproducibility. I also develop freely available course material and teach Python and R in academic settings, with courses covering programming, data analysis, statistics, and scientific computing.

I contribute to several open-source projects, including [MNE-Python](https://mne.tools), [pybv](https://github.com/bids-standard/pybv), and [PyXDF](https://github.com/xdf-modules/pyxdf), and maintain a number of projects of my own, most notably:

* [MNELAB](https://github.com/cbrnr/mnelab) – graphical user interface for MNE-Python
* [MNExtend](https://github.com/cbrnr/mnextend) – additional functionality for the MNE ecosystem
* [SleepECG](https://github.com/cbrnr/sleepecg) – ECG-based sleep staging and analysis
* [SigViewer](https://github.com/cbrnr/sigviewer) – biosignal visualization
* [SCoT](https://github.com/scot-dev/scot) – EEG source connectivity estimation

I have also contributed to a variety of other open-source projects, including [scikit-learn](http://scikit-learn.org/stable/), [pandas](https://pandas.pydata.org/), [IPython](https://ipython.org/), [PsychoPy](http://www.psychopy.org/), [SciPy](https://www.scipy.org/), [Matplotlib](https://matplotlib.org/), and [BioSig](http://biosig.sourceforge.net/).

You can find my recent work and activity on [GitHub](https://github.com/cbrnr) and [Mastodon](https://scholar.social/@cbrnr){rel="me"}. Feel free to contact me via [email](mailto:clemens.brunner@gmail.com) if you'd like to get in touch.
